title: Systematic errors from scalar slowing-down models in transient SERF magnetometry
summary: Reduced Bloch models of spin-exchange-relaxation-free (SERF) magnetometers commonly describe the coupled electron--nuclear spin dynamics using a single nuclear slowing-down factor. We show that this scalar description becomes inaccurate when the polarization magnitude changes appreciably. We derive an effective Bloch equation with separate longitudinal and transverse slowing-down factors, $q_\parallel(P)$ and $q_\perp(P)$, governing changes in polarization magnitude and direction.
